name: Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S.
summary: Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S. manufactures and sells solar panels to solar power plants in Turkey and internationally. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Ankara, Turkey. Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Kalyon Teknoloji Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
